CORE PRINCIPLE: FACTORING IS UN-MULTIPLYING AREA
Factoring a quadratic is literally finding the length and width of a rectangle! If the tiles
cannot form a solid rectangle without gaps, the trinomial is prime. Zero-pairs (+x and -x)
let you model differences of squares x² - 4 with effortless physical cancellation!
Arrange one +x² tile, six +x rods, and eight +1 units into a solid rectangle. What are its
rail dimensions? (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
→ Assemble with physical blocks, then scan QR code for 3D animated solution.
